en:
Alchemy item No. 9.
The Dice of Fate. Countless probabilities can come into play in any situation. If you could see them, would you be able to accept your own fate? Try these dice and find out.

Mazurite x Milstone
note: Header lines kept on their own lines as in the JP layout; recipe line in the Elm3 RENKIN format ('A x B' after a blank line, the JP bullet '>' dropped). Material names from ITEM.CSV (Mazurite, Milstone).

en:
The ultimate alchemy item.
The Philosopher's Stone.
Only those who have mastered alchemy can obtain it. They say it appears on its own once the conditions are met... but what might those conditions be?
note: Full name in the prose; the 14-byte item name cell uses 'Philos. Stone'.
